$comment: Declarative config for the SPA visual-invariants suite (testing/e2e/tests/spa-visual-invariants.spec.ts). Mirrors testing/mockup-visual/harness.config.json so the invariants applied to the SPA stay structurally identical to those applied to the mockup. Per CLAUDE.md 'Configuration vs. data' - no URLs, selectors, tolerances, or combination matrices live as literals inside the spec.
$comment_layouts: MVP layout axis = swim-lane + workflow-rows. The Matrix layout was removed from MVP and deferred to Phase 2.0; re-add 'matrix' here when Phase 2.0 opens. See testing/e2e/scenarios/deferred-phase-2.0/.

invariants.label: No overlap: env-tag vs deployment box
Connector emerges from source box edge
Connector does not cross any env-tag rect

viewExceptions.$comment: Per-view exceptions to specific invariants, mirroring testing/mockup-visual/harness.config.json#viewExceptions. The Glance exception is the NFR-09 sanctioned overlap of the paired env-tag inside its paired pill.

I1-paired-envtag-inside-paired-box.rationale: SAD NFR-09 exception: in Glance view only, the env label is rendered INSIDE the deployment rectangle. Scope is strictly the PAIRED env-tag inside its OWN paired box; non-paired overlaps remain violations. Invariant 2 (env-tag not clipped) still applies.
